rationale: text_raster_decomposition.py, the lab's per-label text measurement, now measures ink as the luminance distance from the local background in either direction instead of only pixels brighter than it, so dark-on-light labels are measured by their glyphs. It is offline validation tooling: it reads PNGs and a capture's DOM snapshot and writes a report. No design-import, Chromium capture, rendering, DesignIR or packaging behaviour changes, and no authority moves. The import-design skill gains a note saying so.
